lines.text: Various clipping fixes in Rush maps
Fixed visualization of weapon inaccuracy + spread
Enabled grenade crosshairs in freeze time for insta-smokes (just hold any grenade attack button)
Allowed negative gaps for classic dynamic crosshair style
Changed the classic dynamic crosshair alpha increments to 0.01
Scope dot scale and color preferences are now included in the new crosshair share code
Changed the format of the crosshair share code to accommodate newly included crosshair settings
